en.meta.title: Trong Phat Vo — Computer Science, Simulation & Machine Learning
en.meta.description: Trong Phat Vo is a Computer Science student and research assistant at RWTH Aachen, working on 3D simulation, OpenStreetMap city generation, algorithms and machine learning.
en.meta.schemaName: Trong Phat Vo — Computer Science, Simulation & Machine Learning
en.meta.jobTitle: Computer Science student and student research assistant
en.hero.role: Computer Science student & student research assistant.
en.hero.intro: Building 3D simulation environments and OpenStreetMap city models at RWTH Aachen. Studying machine learning and algorithms.
en.hero.mapAlt: A schematic city model with street geometry, building blocks and a traced route; an illustration of the Bicycle Simulation work, not a project screenshot
en.about.label: PERSPECTIVE
en.about.title: From hardware registers to constructed worlds.
en.about.body: My work moves between the small mechanics of software and the environments in which systems have to act. At RWTH Aachen I build simulations; in coursework I study machine learning and algorithms; in C and C++ I work close to the machine.
en.work.label: EXPERIENCE
en.work.title: Simulate. Evaluate. Explain.
en.work.intro: Simulation, evaluation and teaching—three ways of making ideas clearer through practice.
en.work.one.org: Institute of Automatic Control · RWTH Aachen University
en.work.one.title: Making a city runnable.
en.work.one.summary: I develop 3D simulation environments and tools for research projects using Unity and C#.
en.work.one.fizzy: Developed environments for the Fizzy-Ball project.
en.work.one.bicycle: Built an OpenStreetMap world-generation tool and integrated OSM datasets to automate realistic city models for the Bicycle Simulation project.
en.work.one.school: Also organized the Fizzy Summer School 2025.
en.work.two.org: German National Computer Science Competition · BWINF
en.work.two.title: Reading the structure of a solution.
en.work.two.summary: I evaluate and score first-round submissions, identify anti-patterns and give constructive feedback on participants’ underlying data structures.
en.work.three.org: German Institute · Ho Chi Minh City
en.work.three.title: Explaining across languages.
en.work.three.summary: Tutored and mentored students in German language lessons.
en.study.label: EDUCATION
en.study.title: A foundation under construction.
en.study.intro: Computer Science at RWTH Aachen, with a focus on machine learning and algorithms.
en.study.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science · Aachen, Germany
en.study.focus: Focus areas: Machine Learning and Algorithms. Dean’s List 2026.
en.study.highschool: High School Diploma · Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
en.practice.label: TECHNICAL PRACTICE
en.practice.title: A working toolkit.
en.practice.intro: The languages and tools below come from the CV and practical work, grouped by the kinds of problems they help solve.
en.practice.systemsBody: Modern C++ (templates, compile-time evaluation); low-level C with AVR microcontrollers, registers, timers and interrupt service routines for LED matrices; Java; HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.
en.practice.mlBody: Python and PyTorch for machine-learning pipelines, including character-level language models and clinical data extraction; local Qwen and DeepSeek deployment; DeepLearning.AI courses on Coursera.
en.practice.prototypingBody: Unity and C# for 3D simulation, OpenStreetMap datasets for city generation, plus Git and LaTeX.
